text:
In Hamm the median asking rent stands at 8.1 €/m², up 1.5 % year‑on‑year and 23.2 % over the last five years, placing the city 35th of the 37 most expensive markets. The market is balanced, with 32 days on market and 21 % of listings let within a week.

Affordability remains moderate: a 60 m² unit costs about 486 €/month, while the rent‑burden for two residents is 12.6 % and the vacancy rate sits at 1.8 %. Asking rents are roughly 41 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 5.75 €/m².

The model‑based forecast for the next 12 months expects median asking rents of 8.53 €/m², ranging between 8.27 €/m² and 8.73 €/m², a 5.2 % increase.
